Introduction

XENO-T was a five-member boy group under Hunus Entertainment, originally debuting as ToppDogg with 13 members on October 24, 2013, with the mini album Dogg's Out.

On February 21, 2018, they rebranded as XENO-T, with Sanggyun (A-Tom) not continuing after his time with JBJ. The new name combined “xenogeneic” and “top-class.”

They re-debuted in Japan on May 30, 2018, with the single "Doko ni Ite mo".

The group was confirmed disbanded by Xero during a livestream in September 2021.
